2	name: stdo-work
3	description: Execute or coordinate one admitted STDO work item through its lawful re-entry point. Use for STDO requirements, design, code or test work, including issuing bounded work to a separate Worker. Do not invoke for generic non-STDO development.
4	---
5	
6	# STDO Work
7	
8	Deliver the smallest causally closed change authorized by one exact work basis.
9	The admitted re-entry point decides where work begins.
10	
11	## Start With Your Own Control Intake
12	
13	Read the exact own contract or intake named in the request before any general
14	search or project read. Bind your own permitted inputs, exclusions and return
15	route, then apply [Control Intake](../../references/COORDINATED_HANDOFF.md#control-intake).
16	This applies to issuer, recipient and direct work. Use named control routes;
17	do not start with directory inventories, memory searches or neighbouring
18	prompts. A Worker’s access never becomes its issuer’s access. Check the actual
19	host boundary before relying on excluded information staying unavailable.
20	
21	## Choose The Entry
22	
23	If receiving a coordinated packet, apply
24	[Receive](../../references/COORDINATED_HANDOFF.md#receive) before the general
25	discovery, classification or subject reads below. After validation, use this
26	skill's ordinary procedure within that packet; return its closed work result
27	through the named surface and consumer, then stop.
28	
29	If the active frame coordinates this work across a material boundary, use
30	[Issue](../../references/COORDINATED_HANDOFF.md#issue). Select the authorized
31	unit from its existing carrier, bind the Worker additions of
32	`EXECUTIVE_BASELINE` §19 and dispatch a recipient of this same skill. The
33	issuer consumes [the return](../../references/COORDINATED_HANDOFF.md#evaluate-the-return)
34	under §12 steps 3–4 and determines required review; it does not fall through
35	into construction in its Executive frame. If the grant requires another
36	actor, a same-actor role change is insufficient.
37	
38	Otherwise follow the direct path below. A sufficient direct Writer invocation
39	needs no added coordinator, Worker, ticket or review. The accepted frame basis
40	and actual authority decide; the requested mode alone grants nothing.
41	
42	## Select The Product Basis
43	
44	Read and apply
45	[`PRODUCT_BASIS.md`](../../references/PRODUCT_BASIS.md) before drafting an
46	execution contract or changing any surface. Continue only from its exactly-one
47	verified selection; that selection grants no work or mutation authority.
48	
49	## Acquire The Deciding Owners
50	
51	Enter through the verified definition's declared bootstrap entrypoint. Then
52	acquire what this work needs under the selected basis's `ACTIVATION.md`
53	section 2, Acquisition: a derived surface whose sources are current where one
54	serves the task, such as a verbatim frame of the cut, and otherwise the owning
55	sections that decide the task's questions. Acquire only from the exact
56	selected basis; a candidate source, a version-line selector or another basis
57	is no substitute. Acquisition is read-only and grants no role, operation or
58	decision; effectful work still needs the admitted contract below. Before
59	dependent action, return a missing binding (no available frame declaring what
60	the evaluation needs, or an absent or unverifiable basis) with the outcome
61	that section names.
62	
63	## Classify From The Available Evidence
64	
65	Apply the selected basis's intake and agentic-construction rules
66	(`SPEC_METHOD.md` sections 4 and 8, `ACTIVATION.md` section 1). Use declared source/worksite/proof tools to compute the affected owner
67	and authority-layer routes, the complete relevant Public serialized membership
68	and value delta, and accepted-design trace coverage. Bind their exact inputs,
69	producer, output and freshness. A file diff alone is not a Public comparison;
70	an existing trace is not a judgment of semantic sufficiency. Missing targets,
71	serialization or trace mappings remain explicit unknowns. Do not invent a
72	tool result or make the STDO distribution manager a worksite analyzer.
73	
74	Reuse applicable computed facts and recorded classification/materiality
75	judgments from the existing work carrier. Check the question, subject, basis,
76	support and revising observation; a different role alone does not require
77	reclassification. Judge only the residual needed to select the smallest lawful
78	path and record its basis once. An unresolved owner choice stays with its owner.
79	Use one bounded discriminator when it can resolve a material unknown.
80	
81	Distinguish a failed candidate from a changed requested outcome. If a helper
82	edit violates an unchanged Public requirement, reject or repair the candidate
83	inside the existing grant. Re-enter the requirement owner when the selected
84	outcome needs changed governing meaning. Candidate bytes cannot choose that
85	outcome or enlarge the grant.
86	
87	## Establish The Work Basis
88	
89	1. Establish applicable upstream work authority under the verified definition
90	   and immutable basis. Without it, stop before
91	   selecting a carrier; a ticket cannot substitute for that authority. Then
92	   select the first applicable source for one run-scoped execution contract:
93	
94	   - reuse an exact admitted durable ticket when it covers the work;
95	   - otherwise require one authorized durable ticket only when work or an
96	     obligation needs independent state beyond its admitted sprint or, outside
97	     a sprint, beyond the current run;
98	   - otherwise use the admitted sprint plus one manifest-local iteration entry
99	     when the work ends by sprint close; or
100	   - otherwise use an intake draft for work that ends in the current run.
101	
102	   Do not invoke `stdo-ticket` automatically. Absence of a ticket neither
103	   requires nor authorizes creating one.
104	2. Bind the contract's current Goal or exact work instruction, `change_intent`,
105	   change class, re-entry point, `target_truth`, relevant `superseded_truth`,
106	   `closure_law`, governing requirement and accepted design, checkpoint,
107	   affected relation set, write territory, evaluation criteria, non-closure
108	   conditions, proof surface, and one Product-bound durable result/evidence
109	   surface. If that result surface is unavailable or unauthorized, admission
110	   must refuse.
111	3. Validate and admit or reject that exact contract. Drafting, admission, and
112	   execution may occur in the same invocation, but ticket presence, `active`
113	   status, a generic work request, or the model's own draft cannot supply
114	   admission. Continue only after deterministic admission or an exact human
115	   override of the bounded contract. Record the Product-bound admitting
116	   mechanism and authority, exact contract identity or digest, decision, and
117	   evidence. If those coordinates are absent, return the missing authority and
118	   stop.
119	   Consume an existing exact owner instruction or admitted grant when it
120	   already covers this contract; cite it instead of requesting the same
121	   authorization again. Record the binding, not another approval round.
122	4. Re-enter at the first changed layer and flow forward:
123	
124	   - requirement change: establish the successor/current requirement as the
125	     sole operative truth; supersede or withdraw a published live domain
126	     artifact instead of mutating it in place;
127	   - design change: admit the structural decision before implementation relies
128	     on it; or
129	   - realization change: prove upstream Goals, Intent, Product, requirements,
130	     and accepted design remain unchanged.
131	5. If work discovers an obligation that needs state beyond its local carrier
132	   boundary, do not claim closure or create a ticket without authority. Persist
133	   it only when the current exact grant already includes ticket-state mutation
134	   for that obligation. Otherwise retain it in the contract's named durable
135	   result/evidence surface or an already-authorized enclosing carrier, mark
136	   closure withheld, and return the required re-entry plus an explicit
137	   `stdo-ticket` route without invoking it. A conversation return alone is not
138	   durable evidence.
139	
140	## Construct And Prove
141	
142	Use the accepted Project Reference-Frame Basis to determine applicable
143	evaluations, including those required by an affected owner. A known false
144	condition omits that evaluation; an unknown condition is unresolved, not
145	false: it needs a bounded resolution or an explicit residual, and the claim
146	that depends on it is withheld until evidence or the owning decision
147	resolves it (ACTIVATION §1 Applicability). Missing required
148	results cannot count as satisfied. Availability of a frame does not require activating it.
149	
150	When that basis permits direct Writer use and one sufficient context/grant
151	covers the outcome, construct directly without an additional coordinating
152	activation, Reviewer or durable ticket. Activate the coordination the
153	applicable configuration selects for a material dependency, authority or
154	context boundary. While occupying Executive, do not edit files or
155	Git state; the same actor must first enter a separately bound Writer activation.
156	An actual independence requirement still needs an independent capable actor.
157	One exact Writer grant may cover its declared construction, status and checkpoint
158	sequence. Record actual role transitions; unchanged status alone does not need
159	a new activation or wholesale rehash. Refresh bindings on material change.
160	
161	1. Work inside the smallest coherent causal cone and exact write territory.
162	   Read material producers, consumers and owners across that cone within the
163	   access grant; narrow write territory is not a narrower reasoning boundary.
164	   Return cross-territory repairs to their owner.
165	   Preserve solution space where variation cannot change a governed property.
166	2. Implement and self-review the bounded change.
167	3. Derive tests through:
168	
169	   ```text
170	   work carrier -> triage -> re-entry -> requirement/design/module/closure law
171	   ```
172	
173	4. Use the cheapest focused falsifier adequate for the claim. Add integration,
174	   installed-development, harnessed sandbox, or live sandbox evidence only
175	   where the Product claim requires it. A real probabilistic boundary requires
176	   a live lane.
177	5. Reconcile authority, design, implementation, tests, and displaced rival
178	   paths before claiming a candidate.
179	   Consume established facts while their exact subject, basis, scope,
180	   provenance and validity apply. Function boundaries alone do not invalidate
181	   them; mutation, rollback, authority/basis change and actual trust boundaries
182	   retain their applicable checks. For material computational composition or
183	   recurrence, inspect the complete path and its accumulated work under the
184	   owning design and optional frame refinement. Qualify declared workloads and
185	   operational assumptions rather than inferring adequacy from local green.
186	   Retire superseded responsibility; retained mechanisms need a supported
187	   obligation, owner, purpose, scope and cost, and temporary ones a removal
188	   trigger. Audit affected test predicates against the supported operating and
189	   threat model; an excluded threat cannot require a replacement guard.
190	6. Return the exact candidate and stop at a delegated return boundary.
191	   Product-owned decision authority, or an
192	   authorized Executive when that profile is adopted, decides whether Product,
193	   qualification, release, risk, or admitted-work law requires independence
194	   and separately activates `stdo-review`.
195	
196	For a selected repair pass, apply [the selected review flow](../../references/COORDINATED_HANDOFF.md#review-flow-from-the-selected-basis):
197	bind linked findings/items, exact repaired subject, failing-before/passing-after
198	reproduction and the declared suite. Identify tests versus any required
199	independent recheck honestly. Keep authorized landing separate from work
200	closure and release; a local repair does not automatically add a review round.
201	
202	Keep reusable judgments and owner rulings in the existing carrier: exact
203	question, subject/basis, supporting computed evidence, actor and authority,
204	conclusion, scope, uncertainty and revising observation. Preserve the original
205	owner ruling separately from interpretation. Invalidate the affected claim
206	when one of the invalidators of `ACTIVATION.md` section 7 occurs; retain
207	unrelated valid results. Reuse does not
208	manufacture an owner ruling or satisfy required independent assessment.
209	
210	On repricing, retain, supersede, defer or withdraw each affected obligation with
211	its owner/evidence links in this carrier. Present the short consequence delta;
212	"continue" does not accept an undisclosed architectural change. An authorized
213	preservation checkpoint can keep unfinished work with its predecessor,
214	territory, concurrent-writer disposition and durable evidence; it claims no
215	acceptance or publication.
216	
217	Evaluate closure as the conjunction of satisfied applicable obligations,
218	valid supporting evidence, required judgments/rulings and absence of an active
219	non-closure condition. A review event is not completion. Record a satisfied
220	bounded result under the existing state-mutation grant; withhold only the
221	affected claim when a condition is missing. Qualification, publication and
222	consumer adoption retain their separate conditions.
223	
224	## Return
225	
226	Return the exact candidate/checkpoint, changed paths, affected authority,
227	execution-contract admission mechanism/result/evidence, focused and broader
228	proof, non-changes, residuals, and closed or withheld work result. Do not
229	claim acceptance beyond the grant, discard a surviving obligation, or silently
230	continue beyond a delegated return boundary.

bind linked findings/items, exact repaired subject, failing-before/passing-after
reproduction and the declared suite. Identify tests versus any required
independent recheck honestly. Keep authorized landing separate from work
closure and release; a local repair does not automatically add a review round.

Keep reusable judgments and owner rulings in the existing carrier: exact
question, subject/basis, supporting computed evidence, actor and authority,
conclusion, scope, uncertainty and revising observation. Preserve the original
owner ruling separately from interpretation. Invalidate the affected claim
when one of the invalidators of `ACTIVATION.md` section 7 occurs; retain
unrelated valid results. Reuse does not
manufacture an owner ruling or satisfy required independent assessment.

On repricing, retain, supersede, defer or withdraw each affected obligation with
its owner/evidence links in this carrier. Present the short consequence delta;
"continue" does not accept an undisclosed architectural change. An authorized
preservation checkpoint can keep unfinished work with its predecessor,
territory, concurrent-writer disposition and durable evidence; it claims no
acceptance or publication.

Evaluate closure as the conjunction of satisfied applicable obligations,
valid supporting evidence, required judgments/rulings and absence of an active
non-closure condition. A review event is not completion. Record a satisfied
bounded result under the existing state-mutation grant; withhold only the
affected claim when a condition is missing. Qualification, publication and
consumer adoption retain their separate conditions.

## Return

Return the exact candidate/checkpoint, changed paths, affected authority,
execution-contract admission mechanism/result/evidence, focused and broader
proof, non-changes, residuals, and closed or withheld work result. Do not
claim acceptance beyond the grant, discard a surviving obligation, or silently
continue beyond a delegated return boundary.

1	# Coordinated Skill Handoff
2	
3	Use this reference when issuing work to another activation or receiving its
4	packet. A direct invocation with sufficient context and authority follows the
5	skill's ordinary procedure. The active frame and grant decide the branch;
6	writing “Executive”, “Worker” or “receive” in a prompt grants nothing.
7	
8	Start with your own [Control Intake](#control-intake), then resolve only the
9	needed owner sections through [Product Basis Selection](PRODUCT_BASIS.md)
10	on the Product's exact basis. `REFERENCE_FRAME` §11 owns the packet;
11	`ACTIVATION` §1–3, §5 and §7 own admission, acquisition, effects and reuse;
12	`EXECUTIVE_BASELINE` §6, §12–13 and §19 apply where that profile is adopted.
13	This reference supplies their interaction route, not replacement authority.
14	A missing owner route is unresolved; do not substitute a neighbouring cut.
15	
16	## Control Intake
17	
18	This is the first path for **issuer, recipient and direct work**. The issuer's
19	access is its own grant, not the Worker's. A coordinator cannot inspect the
20	subject merely because its Worker may do so.
21	
22	1. Read the exact own contract/intake named in the request first. Bind its
23	   role, allowed control inputs, excluded information, operations and return
24	   route. Do not begin with directory listings, recursive discovery, memory
25	   search or neighbouring files. If the request supplies only a packet, its
26	   authorized control routes are the initial limit; check them against their
27	   authoritative grant before dependent acquisition. If no exact control
28	   route is supplied, use only the request's authorized discovery boundary;
29	   an unresolved boundary returns for clarification rather than being guessed.
30	2. Read the named Product Definition, accepted frame basis and applicable
31	   grant/admission through those control routes. An exact definition path
32	   removes the need to inventory surrounding directories. Verify it with the
33	   [compact source reader](#compact-source-acquisition) or the already-declared
34	   equivalent tool; do not print the manager's complete member inventory into
35	   the actor context. Retain the actual verification identity/result.
36	3. Check the active host binding before relying on an acquisition exclusion:
37	   what context is already supplied, which tools and scopes are actually
38	   enabled, how new reads are confined or supervised, and how results return.
39	   Use exposed capabilities and the admitted run binding, not exploration of
40	   home/configuration files. A fresh session is not a read boundary. If the
41	   required capability is absent, unknown or already violated, stop the
42	   dependent activation with its cause; do not claim a clean frame and
43	   continue. The [host binding](#host-binding) states the specific limits.
44	4. Enter only the branch required by that bound role. Issuer follows Issue;
45	   recipient follows Receive; a sufficient direct task uses the ordinary
46	   skill. Read additional sources only for a material question and through
47	   the admitted routes. The skill's general workflow never widens this intake.
48	
49	## Issue
50	
51	1. **Select the authorized unit.** Verify the current outcome, checkpoint,
52	   selected basis, accepted frame configuration and applicable grant/admission. Use
53	   the applicable entry if the admitted contract supplies an activation
54	   table. Otherwise use its sufficient authorized intake. The carrier can
55	   be a ticket, sprint entry or run contract. Preserve applicable existing
56	   grants; an absent ticket does not require creating one. A missing unit or
57	   material scope change returns to its owning contract/admission route.
58	   Work admission, an assessment grant and read-only orientation are distinct:
59	   apply the relation the selected operation requires, not an automatic
60	   execution contract for every question.
61	2. **Project the admitted unit.** The packet is a reference/verbatim projection
62	   of that unit, not a rewritten operating procedure. Use the compact bindings
63	   below or their equivalent in the existing carrier. Each binding points to
64	   an exact admitted source clause; any inlined grant or condition is quoted
65	   verbatim with its origin. The recipient applies the same skill to those
66	   bindings. Do not rewrite the skill or derive a new decision algorithm.
67	
68	   | Binding | Recipient must be able to establish |
69	   |---|---|
70	   | Task | Activation/frame identity, purpose, requested skill, entry and bounded outcome |
71	   | Basis | Product Definition identity/path, immutable method URI and manifest digest, accepted frame basis and exact subject/checkpoint |
72	   | Authority | Contract/grant identity or digest, applicable admission decision/evidence, actor/role, inherited operations, mutation subject and write territory where applicable |
73	   | Acquisition | Authorized bootstrap/control sources, material read set and routes, tools/channels, exclusions and inline material's provenance |
74	   | Envelope | Required capability, context and resource limits; actual host/inheritance binding; applicable independence conditions |
75	   | Result | Result algebra, durable result/evidence surface, consumer, permitted return projection and any required conjunction/dependency results |
76	   | Continuation | Applicable predecessor's closed result, validity conditions, stop/re-entry conditions and the next decision boundary |
77	   | Unresolved required binding | Missing source, verification or capability; return its cause and required re-entry instead of an executable packet |
78	
79	   Preserve conditional grants as conditions. Do not add inferred conditionals,
80	   read/effect grants, retry permissions or closure rules. An effect grant alone
81	   does not grant acquisition of its output. For example, project these as
82	   separate existing clauses, without filling a missing clause by inference:
83	
84	   ```text
85	   Effect and its condition: <exact admitted clause reference or verbatim quote>
86	   Output acquisition: <exact permitted output clause reference or verbatim quote>
87	   Retry / result / stop: <exact admitted clause references or verbatim quotes>
88	   ```
89	
90	   Put any proposed new interpretation outside the execution packet and return
91	   for its required re-entry. Calling it a derivation or a safety rule does not
92	   make it an inherited grant.
93	
94	   A reference works only if the recipient may resolve it and its meaning is
95	   sufficient for this task. Names and hashes alone do not supply the missing
96	   contract. Inline text remains acquired information: it needs the same
97	   recipient eligibility and provenance as a referenced source. An issuer's
98	   wider access cannot authorize copying excluded information into the packet.
99	   Where the Product declares supported context, preflight, dispatch or evidence
100	   tools, use those contracts and retain their actual receipts. Do not replace
101	   required computation with a hand-written claim or invent tool success. A
102	   receipt keeps its bounded meaning; it neither grants authority nor replaces
103	   source/semantic judgment. Tooling availability creates no new dependency.
104	3. **Check the acquisition the packet prescribes.** Consider command output,
105	   diagnostics, logs, file lists and embedded context as well as direct reads.
106	   For example, requiring verbatim commit output while excluding filenames
107	   that command prints is a contradiction. Resolve it before dispatch using
108	   an already-permitted alternative, or return for the required re-entry.
109	   Redacting output after the recipient has seen it does not undo acquisition.
110	   This check establishes no general proof about arbitrary command behavior;
111	   an unresolved material output boundary prevents that command's use.
112	4. **Bind the host and dispatch.** Apply [Host Binding](#host-binding) and send
113	   the packet to the selected actor with the instruction to invoke this same
114	   skill as its recipient. Do not transfer ambient conversation by default
115	   where the frame excludes it. Record the dispatch/activation identity and
116	   actual mechanism in the existing carrier through its authorized Writer.
117	   If no available authorized mechanism meets the required boundary, retain
118	   the packet and return “not dispatched” with the missing capability. A
119	   prepared packet is not an active Worker or a work result.
120	
121	Keep packet readiness separate from returning a response. If a required
122	control/source verification or capability is unavailable, return the missing
123	binding and the applicable incomplete/refused outcome; do not issue an
124	executable intake or label it ready, complete or closed. “Prepared, not
125	dispatched” applies only when the packet is sufficient and dispatch remains
126	unperformed; its consumer still checks the exact intake before using it.
127	
128	The issuer remains in its coordinating frame. It acquires no mutation grant
129	by arranging the work. Where one same-actor role transition is sufficient and
130	permitted, bind and record that transition explicitly; do not pretend it
131	cleared information already acquired (`EXECUTIVE_BASELINE` §6 and §17).
132	
133	## Receive
134	
135	Do this **before the skill's general discovery, classification or subject
136	reads**, and before effects. The packet permits only its authorized control
137	reads while activation is being checked; it does not validate itself.
138	
139	1. Identify the packet's requested frame, consumer and acquisition boundary.
140	   Read only the named, authorized control inputs needed to verify it: the
141	   Product Definition, exact installed basis, accepted frame basis, contract/grant,
142	   applicable admission evidence and required predecessor result. Apply
143	   [Product Basis Selection](PRODUCT_BASIS.md) inside that search boundary;
144	   do not broaden discovery to find a more convenient definition. If these
145	   control reads cannot lawfully resolve the binding, return the mismatch or
146	   unavailable input without reading the work subject.
147	2. Compare the actual subject/checkpoint, contract, admission, actor/grants,
148	   permitted acquisition and required host properties with the packet. Check
149	   referenced digests/currentness and predecessor validity. Check commands
150	   and inline material against the same recipient boundary as the issuer.
151	   A known mismatch returns `activation_refusal` with its cause and the core
152	   result prescribed by `ACTIVATION` §3; do not manufacture a Worker result
153	   for an activation that never occurred. Keep an unresolved required binding
154	   unresolved and return the owning missing-input/capability re-entry.
155	3. On a valid binding, run this skill's ordinary procedure within the packet's
156	   frame and grant. Reuse the verified selection and still-valid facts; do not
157	   ask for admission again merely because a new actor received the work. A
158	   request to edit, run a command or read another source still needs the
159	   operation/acquisition authority already bound to it.
160	4. Record the skill's closed result on the named surface within its write
161	   grant, then send the permitted return projection to the named consumer.
162	   A read-only recipient returns through the declared read-only channel; an
163	   authorized recorder owns any required persistent write. Include exact
164	   subject/basis, evidence routes, residuals, validity and effect uncertainty.
165	   If the named result relation cannot be fulfilled, report the obstruction;
166	   do not redirect the result to an arbitrary file or claim closure. Stop at
167	   the packet's return boundary.
168	
169	## Evaluate The Return
170	
171	The issuer checks activation identity, exact subject/basis, result variant,
172	evidence scope and invalidators before relying on the return. It acquires
173	only the return projection its own frame permits; a link to a full artifact
174	does not authorize reading it. A digest authenticates bytes, not their claims.
175	
176	Reconcile an effect whose completion or end remains unknown before retry or
177	any dependent action (`ACTIVATION` §3 Effects and §5). A timeout, missing
178	message or lost context is not evidence that no effect occurred. Retain valid
179	progress; do not replay a step merely because its actor changed.
180	
181	Apply the governing result/disposition relation and determine whether the
182	exact candidate requires independent review. Issue `stdo-review` separately
183	where required. Reviewer severity remains its technical assessment; the
184	decision owner assigns priority and boundary effect within its grant
185	(`EXECUTIVE_BASELINE` §12 steps 4–7). Do not turn a closed result into implicit
186	authority to repair, accept, publish or start the next stage.
187	
188	A proposed next action is not an executable activation. Before calling it
189	already authorized or issuing it, bind the actual operation grant and the
190	settled subject/pass grouping required by that contract. If either is missing,
191	return the proposal and exact unresolved binding; do not presume a Writer grant
192	or combine unsettled passes. This checks the existing intake, not a new gate.
193	
194	For an admitted sequence, each continuation uses the previous closed result
195	and current bindings. Retain the boundaries the contract actually declares:
196	neither a new human check-in at every pass nor review only at the end is a
197	universal rule. Refresh affected bindings on material change, not every
198	unchanged status observation (`ACTIVATION` §1 Roles and delegation; §7).
199	
200	## Review Flow From The Selected Basis
201	
202	Acquire the selected basis's `EVALUATION` §5, `TICKETS` §4 and §7, and, where
203	adopted, `EXECUTIVE_BASELINE` §5 and §12. Use their actual clauses. A loaded
204	3.0.4 skill cannot amend an older Product-selected method or silently adopt
205	the candidate's review cadence or optional priority policy.
206	
207	Where that basis contains **Landing, closure and release**, **Declared Product
208	acceptance gates**, **QA cadence and repair rechecks**, and **Review findings
209	and bug items**, route the next decision as follows:
210	
211	1. Name which decision is requested: authorized candidate landing, work
212	   closure, or release. Keep its actual conditions separate. A pending review
213	   alone is not a landing hold; no operation, access or hard-stop waiver follows.
214	2. Bind the exact QA subject, coverage, size and reason. Use the owning recheck
215	   triggers; do not automatically request a new review after every repair or
216	   set a review ratio. Keep test verification distinct from required independent
217	   review, and retain any uncovered subject.
218	3. Return unchanged Reviewer severity. The Executive decides priority and
219	   ownership directly when clear, or delegates bounded grouping/proposals to a
220	   triage Worker when volume warrants it; that Worker changes no assessment.
221	   If the basis selects the 1 highest–5 lowest convention, apply its qualitative
222	   anchors and explicit severity-3 downstream/blast-radius assessment. Material
223	   dependent impact normally calls for repair; contained local deferral needs
224	   a reason and owner. Keep severity 3 distinct from priority P3 and retain old
225	   or alternative scales on their own identities.
226	4. If findings need a durable carrier, use `stdo-ticket` under the exact report
227	   or item-update grant. Bind report ID/path, source linkage and visibility
228	   before the effect. No findings means no bug report; sufficient direct work
229	   gains no redundant ticket. A Reviewer records only its granted report and
230	   makes no candidate repair. The reviewed work item's ledger holds decisions
231	   and repair/verification provenance, not a new copy of the assessment.
232	5. For provisional downstream use, retain exact dependencies and uncertainty.
233	   Check only explicitly declared Product gates; a later material finding
234	   invalidates affected dependent results before further reliance. Keep other
235	   valid work. If a policy or boundary decision is genuinely missing, return
236	   that material choice rather than inventing numeric meanings or a gate.
237	
238	Example: a granted Writer lands candidate C while its selected QA runs. QA
239	reports finding F in the named restricted report R. The Executive retains F's
240	severity, assigns priority and links item B on the reviewed work carrier. A
241	repair returns C2 with its failing-before/passing-after reproduction and
242	declared suite evidence. The Executive applies the selected recheck conditions:
243	tests may verify B when no independent recheck is required; otherwise B awaits
244	that exact report. Neither outcome by itself authorizes release or adopts C2
245	at an explicitly gated downstream boundary.
246	
247	## Host Binding
248	
249	For a strict selected tool-acquisition boundary, use the concrete
250	[host adapter and its limits](HOST_BINDING.md). Do not assume the ordinary
251	host permission prompt or a fresh actor supplies that boundary.
252	
253	Use the host's actually available delegation or separate-session mechanism.
254	Record the selected actor/model where exposed, worksite, supplied packet,
255	inherited history/instructions, available tool/permission settings and return
256	channel. Respect the admitted context/resource envelope. Unknown required
257	properties withhold dispatch; optional unobserved properties are explicit
258	limits. Tool availability alone grants no operation.
259	
260	- **Codex:** inspect the exposed delegation/session controls. Where the host
261	  offers conversation inheritance or forking, choose a packet-only context
262	  when the frame requires it and bind any other automatically supplied
263	  instructions. A resumed actor retains its earlier context; use it only
264	  when that context is permitted. Return and wait through the actual actor
265	  identity, not an invented worker name. If this host has no suitable
266	  delegation mechanism, return the prepared packet without claiming dispatch.
267	- **Claude:** select the available subagent/session mechanism and inspect the
268	  selected agent definition, inherited instructions, tool permissions and
269	  worksite. Supply the packet and target skill explicitly. A subagent label
270	  or a resumed session does not establish a clean context. Return through
271	  the actual task/result mechanism; if its properties cannot meet a required
272	  boundary, return the unsupported activation rather than silently executing
273	  in the issuer's context.
274	
275	Neither host's fresh context alone proves information-flow enforcement or
276	independent assessment. Independence additionally uses `EVALUATION` §3's
277	authorship and evidence conditions and the Product's actor-family policy.
278	Do not broaden permissions, change host configuration or install a runtime
279	to make a dispatch work without the existing authority for those effects.
280	
281	## Compact Source Acquisition
282	
283	Use the bundled [read_basis.py](../scripts/read_basis.py) with the exact manager,
284	store and definition already selected by the control intake. It calls the
285	existing manager's read-only `status --verify` and `resolve`, checks manifest
286	and member digests, and returns identities plus only requested source sections.
287	It performs no discovery, admission, access-policy decision or dispatch.
288	
289	```sh
290	python3 -B <plugin-root>/scripts/read_basis.py check \
291	  --stdo <existing-manager> --store <selected-store> \
292	  --definition <exact-definition>
293	python3 -B <plugin-root>/scripts/read_basis.py read \
294	  --stdo <existing-manager> --store <selected-store> \
295	  --definition <exact-definition> \
296	  --member standards/REFERENCE_FRAME.md --list-headings
297	python3 -B <plugin-root>/scripts/read_basis.py read \
298	  --stdo <existing-manager> --store <selected-store> \
299	  --definition <exact-definition> \
300	  --member standards/REFERENCE_FRAME.md --heading '11. The activation packet'
301	```
302	
303	Replace the placeholders with the named routes; do not discover a different
304	manager/store when one fails. The default store may be used only when the
305	control binding selects it explicitly. Python 3.11+ is the helper's runtime;
306	its absence is an unavailable capability, not permission to install it.
307	`checked` verifies that source projection, not the work. `refused` and
308	`incomplete` supply no positive verification; retain the reason and re-enter
309	only the affected route. A missing or ambiguous heading has no guessed fallback.
310	
311	Use `--list-headings` on an already-permitted member to discover its exact
312	selectors rather than guessing a heading or dumping the owner. The catalog
313	returns verified member identity plus heading names, levels, lines and
314	uniqueness; it supplies no section bodies. Catalog acquisition itself must be
315	permitted. The policy binding should expose its actual approved catalog/read
316	commands and source routes to the actor, so it need not invent commands.
317	
318	The reader supports column-zero ATX headings, comment openers and fenced examples.
319	Quoted/list/indented heading or fence containers, unsupported HTML/setext
320	structures and unfinished comments/fences refuse the entire projection. This
321	closed selector domain is not a general Markdown parser. Refusal supplies no
322	partial section; an alternative exact verified route still needs its own grant.
323	
324	For a handoff, begin with the packet section above. Acquire `EXECUTIVE_BASELINE`
325	§12's particular activation/return subsection only when its decision is needed.
326	For recovery, select `ACTIVATION`'s applicable Effects or work-state subsection.
327	Do not load whole owners or whole frames merely because their names appear in
328	this reference. An already-verified applicable fact need not be rederived for
329	each skill name. Use other exact source routes only when the question requires
330	them, keeping scope and uncertainty visible.
331	
332	## Invocation Examples
333	
334	These are requests to the skill, not substitutes for their referenced grants.
335	Use the host's installed skill invocation syntax or open its exact entrypoint.
336	
337	```text
338	Use stdo-work as issuer for the admitted W1 entry in <carrier at exact identity>.
339	Keep my Executive frame. Issue its permitted packet and evaluate the return.
340	```
341	
342	```text
343	Use stdo-work as recipient of <packet at exact identity>.
344	Check its control bindings before subject reads, execute its authorized unit,
345	and return through the packet's result relation.
346	```
347	
348	```text
349	Use stdo-review to issue the required review of <exact candidate> under
350	<assessment grant>. Preserve its independence conditions and return boundary.
351	```
352	
353	For direct work, “Use stdo-work for <authorized bounded change>” continues to
354	use the ordinary direct path when the accepted configuration permits it.

   the admitted routes. The skill's general workflow never widens this intake.

## Issue

1. **Select the authorized unit.** Verify the current outcome, checkpoint,
   selected basis, accepted frame configuration and applicable grant/admission. Use
   the applicable entry if the admitted contract supplies an activation
   table. Otherwise use its sufficient authorized intake. The carrier can
   be a ticket, sprint entry or run contract. Preserve applicable existing
   grants; an absent ticket does not require creating one. A missing unit or
   material scope change returns to its owning contract/admission route.
   Work admission, an assessment grant and read-only orientation are distinct:
   apply the relation the selected operation requires, not an automatic
   execution contract for every question.
2. **Project the admitted unit.** The packet is a reference/verbatim projection
   of that unit, not a rewritten operating procedure. Use the compact bindings
   below or their equivalent in the existing carrier. Each binding points to
   an exact admitted source clause; any inlined grant or condition is quoted
   verbatim with its origin. The recipient applies the same skill to those
   bindings. Do not rewrite the skill or derive a new decision algorithm.

   | Binding | Recipient must be able to establish |
   |---|---|
   | Task | Activation/frame identity, purpose, requested skill, entry and bounded outcome |
   | Basis | Product Definition identity/path, immutable method URI and manifest digest, accepted frame basis and exact subject/checkpoint |
   | Authority | Contract/grant identity or digest, applicable admission decision/evidence, actor/role, inherited operations, mutation subject and write territory where applicable |
   | Acquisition | Authorized bootstrap/control sources, material read set and routes, tools/channels, exclusions and inline material's provenance |
   | Envelope | Required capability, context and resource limits; actual host/inheritance binding; applicable independence conditions |
   | Result | Result algebra, durable result/evidence surface, consumer, permitted return projection and any required conjunction/dependency results |
   | Continuation | Applicable predecessor's closed result, validity conditions, stop/re-entry conditions and the next decision boundary |
   | Unresolved required binding | Missing source, verification or capability; return its cause and required re-entry instead of an executable packet |

   Preserve conditional grants as conditions. Do not add inferred conditionals,
   read/effect grants, retry permissions or closure rules. An effect grant alone
   does not grant acquisition of its output. For example, project these as
   separate existing clauses, without filling a missing clause by inference:

   ```text
   Effect and its condition: <exact admitted clause reference or verbatim quote>
   Output acquisition: <exact permitted output clause reference or verbatim quote>
   Retry / result / stop: <exact admitted clause references or verbatim quotes>
   ```

   Put any proposed new interpretation outside the execution packet and return
   for its required re-entry. Calling it a derivation or a safety rule does not
   make it an inherited grant.

   A reference works only if the recipient may resolve it and its meaning is
   sufficient for this task. Names and hashes alone do not supply the missing
   contract. Inline text remains acquired information: it needs the same
   recipient eligibility and provenance as a referenced source. An issuer's
   wider access cannot authorize copying excluded information into the packet.
   Where the Product declares supported context, preflight, dispatch or evidence
   tools, use those contracts and retain their actual receipts. Do not replace
   required computation with a hand-written claim or invent tool success. A
   receipt keeps its bounded meaning; it neither grants authority nor replaces
   source/semantic judgment. Tooling availability creates no new dependency.
3. **Check the acquisition the packet prescribes.** Consider command output,
   diagnostics, logs, file lists and embedded context as well as direct reads.
   For example, requiring verbatim commit output while excluding filenames
   that command prints is a contradiction. Resolve it before dispatch using
   an already-permitted alternative, or return for the required re-entry.
   Redacting output after the recipient has seen it does not undo acquisition.
   This check establishes no general proof about arbitrary command behavior;
   an unresolved material output boundary prevents that command's use.
4. **Bind the host and dispatch.** Apply [Host Binding](#host-binding) and send
   the packet to the selected actor with the instruction to invoke this same
   skill as its recipient. Do not transfer ambient conversation by default
   where the frame excludes it. Record the dispatch/activation identity and
   actual mechanism in the existing carrier through its authorized Writer.
   If no available authorized mechanism meets the required boundary, retain
   the packet and return “not dispatched” with the missing capability. A
   prepared packet is not an active Worker or a work result.

Keep packet readiness separate from returning a response. If a required
control/source verification or capability is unavailable, return the missing
binding and the applicable incomplete/refused outcome; do not issue an
executable intake or label it ready, complete or closed. “Prepared, not
dispatched” applies only when the packet is sufficient and dispatch remains
unperformed; its consumer still checks the exact intake before using it.

The issuer remains in its coordinating frame. It acquires no mutation grant
by arranging the work. Where one same-actor role transition is sufficient and
permitted, bind and record that transition explicitly; do not pretend it
cleared information already acquired (`EXECUTIVE_BASELINE` §6 and §17).

## Receive

Do this **before the skill's general discovery, classification or subject
reads**, and before effects. The packet permits only its authorized control
reads while activation is being checked; it does not validate itself.

1. Identify the packet's requested frame, consumer and acquisition boundary.
   Read only the named, authorized control inputs needed to verify it: the
   Product Definition, exact installed basis, accepted frame basis, contract/grant,
   applicable admission evidence and required predecessor result. Apply
   [Product Basis Selection](PRODUCT_BASIS.md) inside that search boundary;
   do not broaden discovery to find a more convenient definition. If these
   control reads cannot lawfully resolve the binding, return the mismatch or
   unavailable input without reading the work subject.
2. Compare the actual subject/checkpoint, contract, admission, actor/grants,
   permitted acquisition and required host properties with the packet. Check
   referenced digests/currentness and predecessor validity. Check commands
   and inline material against the same recipient boundary as the issuer.
   A known mismatch returns `activation_refusal` with its cause and the core
   result prescribed by `ACTIVATION` §3; do not manufacture a Worker result
   for an activation that never occurred. Keep an unresolved required binding
   unresolved and return the owning missing-input/capability re-entry.
3. On a valid binding, run this skill's ordinary procedure within the packet's
   frame and grant. Reuse the verified selection and still-valid facts; do not
   ask for admission again merely because a new actor received the work. A
   request to edit, run a command or read another source still needs the
   operation/acquisition authority already bound to it.
4. Record the skill's closed result on the named surface within its write
   grant, then send the permitted return projection to the named consumer.
   A read-only recipient returns through the declared read-only channel; an
   authorized recorder owns any required persistent write. Include exact
   subject/basis, evidence routes, residuals, validity and effect uncertainty.
   If the named result relation cannot be fulfilled, report the obstruction;
   do not redirect the result to an arbitrary file or claim closure. Stop at
   the packet's return boundary.

## Evaluate The Return

The issuer checks activation identity, exact subject/basis, result variant,
evidence scope and invalidators before relying on the return. It acquires
only the return projection its own frame permits; a link to a full artifact
does not authorize reading it. A digest authenticates bytes, not their claims.

Reconcile an effect whose completion or end remains unknown before retry or
any dependent action (`ACTIVATION` §3 Effects and §5). A timeout, missing
message or lost context is not evidence that no effect occurred. Retain valid
progress; do not replay a step merely because its actor changed.

Apply the governing result/disposition relation and determine whether the
exact candidate requires independent review. Issue `stdo-review` separately
where required. Reviewer severity remains its technical assessment; the
decision owner assigns priority and boundary effect within its grant
(`EXECUTIVE_BASELINE` §12 steps 4–7). Do not turn a closed result into implicit
authority to repair, accept, publish or start the next stage.

A proposed next action is not an executable activation. Before calling it
already authorized or issuing it, bind the actual operation grant and the
settled subject/pass grouping required by that contract. If either is missing,
return the proposal and exact unresolved binding; do not presume a Writer grant
or combine unsettled passes. This checks the existing intake, not a new gate.

For an admitted sequence, each continuation uses the previous closed result
and current bindings. Retain the boundaries the contract actually declares:
neither a new human check-in at every pass nor review only at the end is a
universal rule. Refresh affected bindings on material change, not every
unchanged status observation (`ACTIVATION` §1 Roles and delegation; §7).

## Review Flow From The Selected Basis

Acquire the selected basis's `EVALUATION` §5, `TICKETS` §4 and §7, and, where
adopted, `EXECUTIVE_BASELINE` §5 and §12. Use their actual clauses. A loaded
3.0.4 skill cannot amend an older Product-selected method or silently adopt
the candidate's review cadence or optional priority policy.

Where that basis contains **Landing, closure and release**, **Declared Product
acceptance gates**, **QA cadence and repair rechecks**, and **Review findings
and bug items**, route the next decision as follows:

1. Name which decision is requested: authorized candidate landing, work
   closure, or release. Keep its actual conditions separate. A pending review
   alone is not a landing hold; no operation, access or hard-stop waiver follows.
2. Bind the exact QA subject, coverage, size and reason. Use the owning recheck
   triggers; do not automatically request a new review after every repair or
   set a review ratio. Keep test verification distinct from required independent
   review, and retain any uncovered subject.
3. Return unchanged Reviewer severity. The Executive decides priority and
   ownership directly when clear, or delegates bounded grouping/proposals to a
   triage Worker when volume warrants it; that Worker changes no assessment.
   If the basis selects the 1 highest–5 lowest convention, apply its qualitative
   anchors and explicit severity-3 downstream/blast-radius assessment. Material
   dependent impact normally calls for repair; contained local deferral needs
   a reason and owner. Keep severity 3 distinct from priority P3 and retain old
   or alternative scales on their own identities.
4. If findings need a durable carrier, use `stdo-ticket` under the exact report
   or item-update grant. Bind report ID/path, source linkage and visibility
   before the effect. No findings means no bug report; sufficient direct work
   gains no redundant ticket. A Reviewer records only its granted report and
   makes no candidate repair. The reviewed work item's ledger holds decisions
   and repair/verification provenance, not a new copy of the assessment.
5. For provisional downstream use, retain exact dependencies and uncertainty.
   Check only explicitly declared Product gates; a later material finding
   invalidates affected dependent results before further reliance. Keep other
   valid work. If a policy or boundary decision is genuinely missing, return
   that material choice rather than inventing numeric meanings or a gate.

Example: a granted Writer lands candidate C while its selected QA runs. QA
reports finding F in the named restricted report R. The Executive retains F's
severity, assigns priority and links item B on the reviewed work carrier. A
repair returns C2 with its failing-before/passing-after reproduction and
declared suite evidence. The Executive applies the selected recheck conditions:
tests may verify B when no independent recheck is required; otherwise B awaits
that exact report. Neither outcome by itself authorizes release or adopts C2
at an explicitly gated downstream boundary.

## Host Binding

For a strict selected tool-acquisition boundary, use the concrete
[host adapter and its limits](HOST_BINDING.md). Do not assume the ordinary
host permission prompt or a fresh actor supplies that boundary.

Use the host's actually available delegation or separate-session mechanism.
Record the selected actor/model where exposed, worksite, supplied packet,
inherited history/instructions, available tool/permission settings and return
channel. Respect the admitted context/resource envelope. Unknown required
properties withhold dispatch; optional unobserved properties are explicit
limits. Tool availability alone grants no operation.

- **Codex:** inspect the exposed delegation/session controls. Where the host
  offers conversation inheritance or forking, choose a packet-only context
  when the frame requires it and bind any other automatically supplied
  instructions. A resumed actor retains its earlier context; use it only
  when that context is permitted. Return and wait through the actual actor
  identity, not an invented worker name. If this host has no suitable
  delegation mechanism, return the prepared packet without claiming dispatch.
- **Claude:** select the available subagent/session mechanism and inspect the
  selected agent definition, inherited instructions, tool permissions and
  worksite. Supply the packet and target skill explicitly. A subagent label
  or a resumed session does not establish a clean context. Return through
  the actual task/result mechanism; if its properties cannot meet a required
  boundary, return the unsupported activation rather than silently executing
  in the issuer's context.

Neither host's fresh context alone proves information-flow enforcement or
independent assessment. Independence additionally uses `EVALUATION` §3's
authorship and evidence conditions and the Product's actor-family policy.
Do not broaden permissions, change host configuration or install a runtime
to make a dispatch work without the existing authority for those effects.

## Compact Source Acquisition

Use the bundled [read_basis.py](../scripts/read_basis.py) with the exact manager,
store and definition already selected by the control intake. It calls the
existing manager's read-only `status --verify` and `resolve`, checks manifest
and member digests, and returns identities plus only requested source sections.
It performs no discovery, admission, access-policy decision or dispatch.

```sh
python3 -B <plugin-root>/scripts/read_basis.py check \
  --stdo <existing-manager> --store <selected-store> \
  --definition <exact-definition>
python3 -B <plugin-root>/scripts/read_basis.py read \
  --stdo <existing-manager> --store <selected-store> \
  --definition <exact-definition> \
  --member standards/REFERENCE_FRAME.md --list-headings
python3 -B <plugin-root>/scripts/read_basis.py read \
  --stdo <existing-manager> --store <selected-store> \
  --definition <exact-definition> \
  --member standards/REFERENCE_FRAME.md --heading '11. The activation packet'
```

Replace the placeholders with the named routes; do not discover a different
manager/store when one fails. The default store may be used only when the
control binding selects it explicitly. Python 3.11+ is the helper's runtime;
its absence is an unavailable capability, not permission to install it.
`checked` verifies that source projection, not the work. `refused` and
`incomplete` supply no positive verification; retain the reason and re-enter
only the affected route. A missing or ambiguous heading has no guessed fallback.

Use `--list-headings` on an already-permitted member to discover its exact
selectors rather than guessing a heading or dumping the owner. The catalog
returns verified member identity plus heading names, levels, lines and
uniqueness; it supplies no section bodies. Catalog acquisition itself must be
permitted. The policy binding should expose its actual approved catalog/read
commands and source routes to the actor, so it need not invent commands.

The reader supports column-zero ATX headings, comment openers and fenced examples.
Quoted/list/indented heading or fence containers, unsupported HTML/setext
structures and unfinished comments/fences refuse the entire projection. This
closed selector domain is not a general Markdown parser. Refusal supplies no
partial section; an alternative exact verified route still needs its own grant.

For a handoff, begin with the packet section above. Acquire `EXECUTIVE_BASELINE`
§12's particular activation/return subsection only when its decision is needed.
For recovery, select `ACTIVATION`'s applicable Effects or work-state subsection.
Do not load whole owners or whole frames merely because their names appear in
this reference. An already-verified applicable fact need not be rederived for
each skill name. Use other exact source routes only when the question requires
them, keeping scope and uncertainty visible.

## Invocation Examples

These are requests to the skill, not substitutes for their referenced grants.
Use the host's installed skill invocation syntax or open its exact entrypoint.

```text
Use stdo-work as issuer for the admitted W1 entry in <carrier at exact identity>.
Keep my Executive frame. Issue its permitted packet and evaluate the return.
```

```text
Use stdo-work as recipient of <packet at exact identity>.
Check its control bindings before subject reads, execute its authorized unit,
and return through the packet's result relation.
```

```text
Use stdo-review to issue the required review of <exact candidate> under
<assessment grant>. Preserve its independence conditions and return boundary.
```

For direct work, “Use stdo-work for <authorized bounded change>” continues to
use the ordinary direct path when the accepted configuration permits it.

# Product Basis Selection

Use this read-only procedure before every STDO workflow skill. It selects and
verifies one Product basis; it grants no mutation, execution, review,
disposition, installation, or continuation authority.

## Procedure

1. State the requested Product scope from the exact request and Product-owned
   identities or claims. If the request does not distinguish the Product, keep
   the scope unresolved.
2. Discover candidate `stdo_<label>.json` definitions within the authorized
   workspace search boundary. A filename, current directory, nearest file, or
   directory nesting is discovery evidence only and cannot select a Product or
   imply composition.
3. Determine applicability from each definition's Product-definition identity
   and its Product-owned `what`, `how`, `ticketing`, bounded-context, and
   explicit composition bindings. A path is selecting evidence only when the
   definition itself binds it to the requested Product scope.
4. Require exactly one applicable definition. For zero applicable definitions,
   return the unresolved scope. For multiple applicable definitions, return
   every remaining definition identity and path and request Product-scope
   disambiguation. Do not choose by proximity, familiarity, recency, or label.
5. Verify the selected definition read-only:

   ```sh
   stdo status --definition <selected-definition> --verify
   ```

   Require the reported definition path and identity, immutable basis URI, and
   manifest SHA-256 to match the selected definition, with `installed: true`,
   `valid: true`, and no failures. Do not sync, adopt, install, fall back to
   mutable source, or select a nearby Product during this procedure.
6. Return the requested Product scope, definition identity and path, immutable
   basis URI or cut, manifest SHA-256, and verification result. Only then may
   the calling skill continue under its own effect and authority boundary.

Zero definitions, multiple applicable definitions, failed verification, or any
identity, path, basis, manifest, installation, or validity mismatch stops the
calling skill before effects. Report the exact candidates or mismatch and the
required re-entry; do not repair it implicitly.

## Read A Member From That Basis

After the selected basis has verified, resolve each required member through
that same immutable basis. A route consists of the member's package-relative
path and, where needed, a heading anchor within it. For example:

```sh
STDO_BASIS_URI='stdo://releases/<selected-immutable-cut>/'
stdo resolve "${STDO_BASIS_URI}manifest.json"
stdo resolve "${STDO_BASIS_URI}standards/ACTIVATION.md"
```

Use the basis URI returned by the verified Product Definition. Read the
manifest whose digest equals that definition's `manifest_sha256`. Require
`ACTIVATION.md` in its standards inventory and require the resolved file's
SHA-256 to equal that member's declared digest. Apply the same check to every
other selected member. The resolver's returned URI must equal the requested
URI, and its path must be in that verified installation. A path alone proves
neither membership nor content identity.

Resolve the member without its fragment, then locate the exact anchor in
those verified bytes; for example, `#7-closed-result-and-reuse` selects
ACTIVATION's reuse owner. A missing member, anchor, manifest mismatch or
content mismatch leaves the route unresolved. Acquire no replacement from a
checkout, moving selector, later cut or neighbouring Product. A frame is a
member too: verify its own bytes and the local sources and section digests
listed in `standards/frames/FRAME_INPUTS.json` before treating it as current.
This identity check does not establish semantic fidelity or task sufficiency.

Return the exact basis URI and manifest digest with each acquired member,
its member digest, selected anchor and any unresolved dependency. The
calling skill retains its own authority and effect boundary.

---

# STDO project tools

Deliver actual checked artifacts for the nominated source. Use Bash and Read for public tool calls and the authorized file writer for each Claude-authored task. The [native work skill](../stdo-work/SKILL.md) owns governed work, authority and coordinated handoff; this extension owns only the public tool route. The selected existing grant remains sufficient within its exact scope.

Read the installed [runtime configuration](../../stdo-3.0.5/CONFIG.json). Run its installed `manage_skills.py check-runtime --configuration CONFIG.json` before relying on the provider. Use the returned exact `python`, `ac_root` and `stdo`. Pass that `stdo` invocation explicitly wherever the public command accepts `--stdo`, including project `prepare`; the executable carries the selected manager/store binding. Its method selection verifies the installed runtime anchor only. Resolve each nominated Product Definition independently and preserve its selected basis; installing these Skills never adopts or upgrades that Product. Generic project/code tools receive the nominated definition unchanged. FD operations require an exact supported target basis and must refuse an unsupported one. A failed or stale binding withholds the dependent action; do not choose another install or write a replacement receipt.


For a representation build, follow [project build](references/project.md). For an existing model or proof, follow [formal reading](references/formal.md). For requirement-to-code/test-source mapping, follow [code tracing](references/code.md). Load only the needed branch.

Return the actual artifact paths, exact source/method identities, checks performed, failures and remaining obligations. Graph structure and a Lean closure/projection proof do not prove source-prose fidelity, code correctness or acceptance. A prepared prompt is not a built representation, a saved `verified` field is not a fresh proof check, and a child completion cannot authorize an unrequested stage.

=== RULES.md
# Bounded receipt service
The service records whether a requested delivery is admitted.
Delivery requires an issuer grant, a recipient grant and current evidence.
If any required grant is absent or evidence is stale, refuse delivery.

=== README.md
# Controlled project

## Intent
Build the declared receipt-service representation.

## Scope
This disposable project only.

## Frame
Existing Root qualification instruction.

## Implementation
Public project provider with current-host authored answers.

# Operator qualification grant
Root's current owner-authorized STDO3.0.5 qualification selects this disposable
Product only. The operator may create the exact policies, inputs and evidence
surfaces. The named executive may acquire, assemble, preflight and dispatch only
the registered local recipient under the existing work grant. That recipient may
write only outputs/ in this case. No production work, Product adoption, global
configuration, publication or Git effect is granted. Negative variants remove
the named issuer or recipient permission and must preserve the resulting refusal.
The process fixture receives the exact context and records only receipt bytes and
one local counter. Process-end observation leaves external descendants/effects
unknown; no reconciliation is inferred from a process exit.

43	def contained(root, name):
44	    name = gen.safe_relative(name.removeprefix("./").rstrip("/"))
45	    path = root / name
46	    require(path.resolve().is_relative_to(root), "source escapes nominated project: " + name)
47	    require(not any(p.is_symlink() for p in (path, *path.parents) if p.is_relative_to(root)),
48	            "source redirects through a symlink: " + name)
49	    return path

52	def sources(root, selections, checker=None):
53	    files = {}
54	    excluded = set()
55	    for selection in selections:
56	        path = contained(root, selection)
57	        require(path.exists(), "selected source missing: " + selection)
58	        candidates = [path]
59	        while candidates:
60	            candidate = candidates.pop()
61	            relative = candidate.relative_to(root).as_posix()
62	            if EXCLUDED.intersection(candidate.relative_to(root).parts):
63	                excluded.add(relative)
64	                continue
65	            contained(root, relative)
66	            directory = candidate.is_dir()
67	            gen._selected_path(checker, candidate, directory=directory)
68	            if directory:
69	                # Guard a directory before enumerating its children, including
70	                # a reserved origin subtree beneath a lawful broad source root.
71	                candidates.extend(reversed(sorted(candidate.iterdir())))
72	                continue
73	            raw = regular(candidate, checker)
74	            require("\r" not in raw.decode("utf-8"), "source requires LF UTF-8: " + relative)
75	            files[relative] = {"path": relative, "sha256": gen.sha(raw), "bytes": len(raw)}
76	    require(files, "no eligible source files selected")
77	    return list(files[p] for p in sorted(files)), sorted(excluded)

80	def verify_definition(path, manager, checker=None):
81	    definition = gen._decode(regular(path, checker))
82	    require(definition.get("kind") == "stdo.product-definition", "expected a Product Definition")
83	    basis = definition["constitution"]["stdo"]["basis"]
84	    require(basis["uri"].startswith("stdo://releases/v3."), "project source binding requires an exact STDO 3.x cut")
85	    result = subprocess.run([manager, "status", "--definition", str(path), "--verify"],
86	                            capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
87	    require(result.returncode == 0, "project method verification failed: " + (result.stderr or result.stdout)[:2000])
88	    observed = gen._decode(result.stdout.encode())
89	    require(observed.get("valid") is True and observed.get("installed") is True
90	            and not observed.get("failures") and observed.get("basis") == basis["uri"]
91	            and observed.get("manifest_sha256") == basis["manifest_sha256"]
92	            and observed.get("definition_id") == definition["product"]["definition_id"],
93	            "manager result does not verify the selected project basis")
94	    return definition, observed

97	def prepare(project, definition, output, *, selections=None, mode="direct", upstream=None,
98	            title=None, manager="stdo", chunk_chars=20_000, formal_checker=None):
99	    if formal_checker is not None:
100	        ac_formal_gate.validate_config(formal_checker)
101	    gen._selected_path(formal_checker, Path(project).absolute(), directory=True)
102	    gen._selected_path(formal_checker, Path(output).absolute(), write=True)
103	    project = Path(project).resolve(strict=True)
104	    require(project.is_dir(), "nominated project must be a directory")
105	    definition = Path(definition)
106	    definition = definition if definition.is_absolute() else project / definition
107	    require(definition.resolve().is_relative_to(project), "definition is outside nominated project")
108	    definition = contained(project, definition.relative_to(project).as_posix())
109	    gen._selected_path(formal_checker, definition)
110	    product, observed = verify_definition(definition, manager, formal_checker)
111	    require((definition.parent / product["product"]["source_project"]).resolve() == project,
112	            "definition source_project differs from nominated project root")
113	    output = Path(output).absolute()
114	    require(not output.is_symlink() and not output.exists(), "run already exists; inspect status to resume")
115	    output = output.resolve()
116	    require(not project.is_relative_to(output), "run output overlaps nominated project")
117	    what = product["what"]
118	    def project_relative(reference):
119	        require(isinstance(reference, str) and not Path(reference).is_absolute()
120	                and ":" not in reference and "#" not in reference,
121	                "default source requires a local definition-relative file or directory")
122	        path = definition.parent / reference
123	        require(not any(p.is_symlink() for p in (path, *path.parents) if p.is_relative_to(project)),
124	                "default source redirects through a symlink")
125	        path = path.resolve()
126	        require(path.is_relative_to(project), "default WHAT source escapes nominated project")
127	        return path.relative_to(project).as_posix()
128	    chosen = selections or [project_relative(x) for x in (what["intent"], what["product"], *what["specification"])]
129	    require(all(isinstance(x, str) for x in chosen), "source selections must be relative paths")
130	    for name in chosen:
131	        require(not output.is_relative_to(contained(project, name)), "run output is inside a selected source tree")
132	    files, excluded = sources(project, chosen, formal_checker)
133	    definition_bytes = regular(definition, formal_checker)
134	    identity = {"definition_id": product["product"]["definition_id"],
135	                "definition_sha256": gen.sha(definition_bytes), "method": product["constitution"]["stdo"]["basis"],
136	                "files": files}
137	    manifest = {"profile": "ac.generation.corpus/1", "subject_id": "urn:a-c:project:" + gen.digest(identity),
138	                **identity, "selection": chosen, "scope": "explicit" if selections else "declared-WHAT-only",
139	                "excluded": excluded}
140	    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
141	    gen.save(output / "source-manifest.json", manifest, exclusive=True)
142	    (output / "product-definition.json").write_bytes(definition_bytes)
143	    gen.save(output / "method-verification.json", observed, exclusive=True)
144	    plan = gen.prepare(project, output / "source-manifest.json", output / "generation", mode,
145	                       Path(upstream) if upstream else None, chunk_chars, formal_checker=formal_checker)
146	    if mode == "graphify-ac":
147	        gen.build_discovery(output / "generation", Path(upstream))
148	    record = {"profile": PROFILE, "project": str(project), "definition": str(definition),
149	              "definition_sha256": gen.sha(definition_bytes), "method": identity["method"],
150	              "manager": manager, "selection": chosen, "files": files, "excluded": excluded,
151	              "manifest_sha256": gen.sha(regular(output / "source-manifest.json", formal_checker)),
152	              "plan_sha256": gen.sha(regular(output / "generation/plan.json", formal_checker)),
153	              "subject_id": manifest["subject_id"], "title": title or product["product"]["name"] + " · Constraints",
154	              "machinery": machinery(formal_checker), "authoring": "host-session; identity is caller-declared; isolation not claimed"}
155	    gen.save(output / "PROJECT.json", record, exclusive=True)
156	    return {"status": "prepared", "run": str(output), "chunks": len(plan["chunks"]), "source_files": len(files),
157	            "subject_id": record["subject_id"], "method": record["method"], "mode": mode}

161	    run = Path(run).absolute()
162	    # Only generation's fixed operator-owned startup metadata is acquired
163	    # before inherited checker selection, as in the existing batch workflow.
164	    startup, checker = gen._startup(run / "generation")
165	    require(checker == startup.get("formal_checker"), "project checker selection changed; prepare a fresh run")
166	    gen._selected_path(checker, run, write=True, directory=True)
